venues.name: Coastal Credit Union Music Park at Walnut Creek

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The box office is open on day-of-show only starting at 12 PM.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Visa, Mastercard, DSC & American Express, and ApplePay (There is a $6.50 ticket service charge at the Box Office.)
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Located at the Box Office. Available after the gates open on Day-Of-Show ONLY. PLEASE BRING A PICTURE ID, THE ACTUAL CREDIT CARD USED TO PURCHASE THE TICKETS, AND YOUR ORDER NUMBER.

venues.parkingDetail: There are 9 lots adjacent to amphitheatre. **Accessible parking with a government issued placard/hangtag/plate does not require the customer to also purchase the premier parking upgrade.** Parking lots generally will open 1 hours prior to show time. Please call our administrative office for exact time. Tailgating / Alcohol in the Parking Lot -There is a City of Raleigh open container ordinance that is in effect in all parking lots. -This City ordinance specifically prohibits open containers of beer or wine. -The State of North Carolina laws also restrict open consumption of liquor of any kind. -Officers from the Raleigh Police Department, Wake County and State of North Carolina Alcohol Beverage Commissions regularly patrol parking lots. -Coastal Credit Union Music Park at Walnut Creek welcomes fans who want to picnic before shows; however, cars must occupy only one parking space. Grills are not permitted on sidewalks, in roadways, near buildings or in any area where guests or property may be damaged. -Glass bottles are also discouraged. -Beer, wine, and mixed drinks are served inside venue with proper I.D. -Please always drink responsibly and appoint a designated driver.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: This venue is accessible. Accessible parking with a government issued placard/hangtag/plate is available and does not require the customer to also purchase the premier parking upgrade.

generalInfo.generalRule: We want you to bring everything you need to make your visit to Coastal Credit Union Music Park at Walnut Creek the best. The items below may vary from show to show, but this listing can be useful as a general guide. If a certain item (listed or unlisted) is essential to your concert enjoyment, please call our administrative offices at 919-831-6400 on the show day for specific information on the show you plan to attend. Our list of items to bring or not bring are designed to be fair to everyone and meet a combination of safety goals including providing smooth access into the venue when we have large crowds. Our goal as your host is to provide an atmosphere that allows for the maximum enjoyment of the entire audience and we apologize in advance if some restrictions may cause you any inconvenience. WHAT TO BRING: -clear plastic, vinyl or PVC tote bags no larger then 12in x 6in x 12in and/or small clutch bags (6in x 9in) -Blankets -Binoculars -Stadium Seat Cushions (with no metal parts) -Ponchos or Rain Jackets -Water: One sealed bottle of water allowed per patron or empty bottle (metal or plastic) up to 1-gallon in size -Food in a clear 1-gallon sized Ziploc type plastic bag Camera Policy: Personal cameras are allowed in the venue. Flash photography, video and removable lens cameras are not permitted without venue approval. WHAT NOT TO BRING: -Non-clear bags larger then 4.5in x 6.5 in and clear bags larger than 12in x 6in x 12in -Alcohol -Bottles -Cameras -Coolers -Illegal Drugs. -Laser Pointers -Ipads -Umbrellas (small tote size only please) -Aerosol bug spray cans -Chairs with leg or roof attachments -Pets (except service animals) -Recorders (audio or video) -Weapons -Strollers. Please note that strollers are welcome through the gates and on the lawn but cannot be taken into the reserved seating area. Fans may check them at our Guest Service Booths. -Small camping or lawn chairs with no leg or roof attachments Arrive at the gates with NO BAGS of any kind and head into the show quickly via our "No Bags Express Lanes" located at the Main Gate! The No Bag Express Lane is located to the LEFT of the Main gates.
generalInfo.childRule: Kids Under 2: -Children under the age of 2 years will be admitted free to all events as long as they sit in the Adult patrons lap and do not utilize an additional seat. -This policy applies to both the lawn seating area and the reserved seating areas.

events.name: Carolina Ballet presents Dracula
events.info: This two-act world premiere delves into the man who came before the legend. Once a loyal servant of the church, he leaves his new bride to fight in its name. When false news of his death reaches home, her longing of reunification comes at the cost of her life. Returning home only to find his beloved gone, he renounces his faith. At this crossroad of ruin, Dracula is born. In search of newfound devotion, this world premiere blends gothic with a deeply human depiction of adoration, piety, and deception. Dracula will feature both the power and nuance of our full company alongside a novel score.

boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, ApplePay, and G-pay.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call tickets can be picked up at the box office or ticket counters one hour prior to the scheduled event. Picture ID required.

venues.parkingDetail: There are multiple parking locations, all conveniently located near the Martin Marietta Center. Click Here to view a parking location map. Accessible parking is available in the Performing Arts Center deck, as well as other locations as notated on the parking location map. Event parking is $10.00 per car, look for the "Event Parking" signs. A dedicated drop-off lane is located on Lichtin Plaza.

generalInfo.generalRule: Guests are required to enter through a security screening, including the use of a metal detector. All bags are also subject to search and must meet our new size requirements. boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: All points of sale will only accept credit or debit via card or mobile pay. This is a cashless venue
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call tickets are available for pickup at the box office. Bring a photo ID that matches the name on the ticket order! Tickets can only be retrieved by the named guest on the list. Guests are not able to leave tickets at Will Call for others to pick up. If tickets or passes are left for you, they are only available at the box office. These items usually arrive close to door time, so please plan accordingly.

venues.parkingDetail: We have two Ritz official, venue-owned parking lots with accessible parking spots. Both lots are $15 to park on show day and can be paid with a credit card, Apple pay, Google pay, tap-to-pay, or cash. Purchase these tickets in advance for a discount! Premier Parking is available to all shows and gets you closest to the venue. We have two options: Front row parking and Gold Reserve parking. Buy in advance as these sell out quickly! CAUTION: Additional parking not designated on the map below IS NOT Ritz-owned, managed, controlled, or maintained and therefore we have no control over your car being towed, ticketed, inaccessible, locked-out or otherwise.

Please visit https://www.ritzraleigh.com/accessibility for information on all venue accessibility.
ada.adaHours: The box office at The Ritz is open on event days starting two hours before doors open. The Box Office can be reached at (919) 424-1400, press 1.

events.name: Accessible Curtain Call From Beyond: Theatre Haunts & History
events.info: This date and time is specifically for an accessible tour route. This thoughtfully designed route allows guests who require the use of the venue's elevators to comfortably experience the highlights of the tour. On this 50-minute guided tour, guests will explore through backstage corridors and performance spaces featuring behind-the-scenes theatre stories, local ghost lore, and fascinating history connected to the building. Each ticket also includes access to The Lounge, Martin Marietta Center's hospitality space featuring gothic-inspired décor, candlelight, and moody touches, along with one signature alcoholic or non-alcoholic drink per person. Please note, this tour is recommended for ages 12 and up.

venues.name: Martin Marietta Center for the Performing Arts

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Hours of operation are Monday-Friday, 10:00AM - 2:00PM and on event days, one hour prior to show time. Our Box Office is located at 2 E South St. and is directly in front of Raleigh Memorial Auditorium. The box office is closed on most federal holidays.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, ApplePay, and G-pay.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call tickets can be picked up at the box office or ticket counters one hour prior to the scheduled event. Picture ID required.

venues.parkingDetail: There are multiple parking locations, all conveniently located near the Martin Marietta Center. Click Here to view a parking location map. Accessible parking is available in the Performing Arts Center deck, as well as other locations as notated on the parking location map. Event parking is $10.00 per car, look for the "Event Parking" signs. A dedicated drop-off lane is located on Lichtin Plaza.

generalInfo.generalRule: Guests are required to enter through a security screening, including the use of a metal detector. All bags are also subject to search and must meet our new size requirements. A small clutch or wallet is recommended and no bags larger than 12" x 12" x 10" will be allowed, this includes backpacks, camera bags, and large purses. *For family shows diaper bags are allowed for guests with infants and toddlers (child must be present). Prohibited items include: outside food and beverage, camera bags, large purses (over 12"x12"x10"), backpacks, and weapons of any kind. No video cameras/recording devices allowed, this includes still cameras. Smoking is not permitted.
generalInfo.childRule: Age 2 and older typically require a ticket, however this may vary by event. This information will be listed on the Ticketmaster event purchase page.

venues.name: The Ritz

boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: Call us at (919) 424-1400 and select the appropriate option for your question, or email TheRitzRaleigh@LiveNation.com. We'll do our best to help you out!
boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The box office at The Ritz is open on event days starting two hours before doors open. The Box Office can be reached at (919) 424-1400, press 1.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: All points of sale will only accept credit or debit via card or mobile pay. This is a cashless venue
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call tickets are available for pickup at the box office. Bring a photo ID that matches the name on the ticket order! Tickets can only be retrieved by the named guest on the list. Guests are not able to leave tickets at Will Call for others to pick up. If tickets or passes are left for you, they are only available at the box office. These items usually arrive close to door time, so please plan accordingly.

venues.parkingDetail: We have two Ritz official, venue-owned parking lots with accessible parking spots. Both lots are $15 to park on show day and can be paid with a credit card, Apple pay, Google pay, tap-to-pay, or cash. Purchase these tickets in advance for a discount! Premier Parking is available to all shows and gets you closest to the venue. We have two options: Front row parking and Gold Reserve parking. Buy in advance as these sell out quickly! CAUTION: Additional parking not designated on the map below IS NOT Ritz-owned, managed, controlled, or maintained and therefore we have no control over your car being towed, ticketed, inaccessible, locked-out or otherwise.

generalInfo.childRule: Our venue is all ages, unless otherwise noted on a show. Children 2 and under do not require a ticket.
